title: Nokia Phone
description: Adds the legendary NOKIA PHONE to Minecraft as a craftable custom item 🗣️🔥
body:
# Intro
Adds the legendary NOKIA PHONE to Minecraft as a craftable custom item. Right-click it to play the classic Nokia sound and call down a massive explosion wherever you aim, as long as you are standing far enough away to survive it.

If you ignore the safety warnings and keep trying to use it too close, the phone will eventually answer anyway...
# Version
This mod is currently for 1.21.11 - 26.2 Fabric! It took a bit to get 'em all together, but we ball.
# Crafting Recipe
![Nokia Phone Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec0a6a784d7136b8bff681d19236512eb0f48352.png)
Shall you ignore the Nokia's warnings... well... prepare for his judgment...
